report:
CRANIAL MRI EXAMINATION:
Technique: Axial plane FSE T2 and FLAIR T2, coronal plane FSE T1, and sagittal plane FSE T2.

Findings:
	Bony structures and subgaleal tissue within the field of view are normal.
	In the evaluation of craniofacial structures; nasal cavity, paranasal sinuses, and mastoid air cells are normal. Concha bullosa is observed in the right middle concha.

	In the evaluation of orbits within the field of view; globes, extraorbital muscles, retrobulbar fat tissue, and optic nerves were evaluated as normal.

	In the posterior fossa series; the fourth ventricle is normal in location, shape, and size. Cerebellar hemispheres appear symmetric, gray-white matter differentiation is unremarkable.
	Brainstem structures, pons, and midbrain are normal.
	Basal cisterns are visualized as open.

	In the supratentorial series; white and gray matter signal intensities are normal in both hemispheres. Ventricular system is symmetric on the midline, size compatible with age.
	A 2.5x3 mm T2-weighted hyperintense microadenoma is observed in the right lobe of the adenohypophysis.
	Basal ganglia and thalami are normal.
	Cortical sulci and gyri are regular.

Impression: Brain MRI findings within normal limits
	    Microadenoma in the right lobe of the adenohypophysis
